pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark brown irregular polygons with high-frequency frilled or serrated edge gradients, creating complex, non-linear boundaries against the lighter corridors.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A network of narrow, light-tan pathways forming a continuous topological grid. Junction nodes are primarily trilateral, with pixel thickness remaining relatively uniform across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the neck and upper shoulder, characterized by fine-textured vertical pixel extensions against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two oxpeckers perched on the upper neck and dorsal ridge, causing localized occlusion and textural deviation from the primary mane profile.
